features: Support up to DDR5 24 DIMM slots (1DPC)
Optional PCIe slot configurations up to 8 PCIe 5.0 x8 or 4 PCIe 5.0 x16 slots or mix and match
Flexible networking options with 1 AIOM networking slot (OCP NIC 3.0 compatible)

Up to 24 front hot-swap 2.5" NVMe/SATA drive bays
 2 M.2 PCIe 3.0 NVMe slots
Capabilities for GPU and CXL 2.0 support
